metadata.description: Claude Code mods by ezoushen — plugins whose behavior lives in hooks modules.

plugins.name: mermaid-pane
plugins.description: Presents mermaid code blocks as ASCII art or images (mmdc locally, mermaid.ink as fallback) — embedded in replies with a /mermaid pane for the session gallery.

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: Preview image paths inline: thumbnails above the prompt editor (1:1 aspect-fill, 4 rows) and in chat rows (aspect-fit, 10 rows). Recognises a real file path ending in a supported image extension, or an [Image #N] token stored by the /image command.
